title: FindingNemo Extraction 3: NEB Monarch Kit
author: Inswasti Cahyani
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bxvvpn66
materials: NEB Monarch® HMW DNA Extraction Kit

We have obtained optimal extractions using the NEB Monarch kit. This combines speed with high quality UHMW DNA. Follow the manufacturer’s instructions as described here , BUT incorporate the following changes as described below. Our most homogeneous extracted DNA samples were obtained by lysis at 600-700 rpm speed using the Monarch kit. This is one area that can be optimised depending on the input sample.

steps.title: Gather Monarch kit and reagents
steps.instruction: Obtain the Monarch® HMW DNA Extraction Kit for Cells & Blood (New England Biolabs catalog #T3050S) and the NEB Elution Buffer II required for the protocol.

steps.title: Determine required cell input
steps.instruction: Use 1 × 10⁶ human cells for a single MinION library load, at least 2 × 10⁶ cells for a PromethION load, and scale proportionally (e.g., ~3 × 10⁶ cells for a 1 Gb genome).

steps.title: Dilute eluted DNA to 250 µL
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL NEB Elution Buffer II to the DNA that was previously eluted with 100 µL buffer, bringing the total volume to 250 µL; perform the dilution gradually to obtain a homogeneous concentration of 50–100 ng/µL.

steps.title: Incubate DNA at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the diluted DNA at 37 °C for 2–3 hours with regular pipette mixing; visually confirm that the viscous DNA blob has dissolved (usually after ~2 h) and extend to 3 h if needed.

steps.title: Quantify DNA and assess homogeneity
steps.instruction: Quantify the DNA using the “UHMW DNA QC” method, calculate the %CV to evaluate homogeneity, and if the DNA is not sufficiently homogeneous, continue incubation at 37 °C before re‑quantifying.

steps.title: Store DNA or proceed to library prep
steps.instruction: Store the DNA at 4 °C, or immediately continue to ultra‑long (UL) library preparation as described in “Modified ULK001”. If only the SQK‑RAD004 kit is available, follow the “Modified RAD004” or “KrazyStarFish (KSF)” library‑preparation protocols. Store at 4 °C for any later use.
